visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with black hair styled in two long braids stands on a rooftop balcony. She wears a black dress with shoulder cutouts and a pearl necklace. In the background, the iconic Hollywood sign is clearly visible on a hillside under a bright, sunny sky. She begins performing a rhythmic dance with stiff, claw-like hand gestures and a focused, slightly playful facial expression. (2) The scene transitions to various locations on Hollywood Boulevard. She is seen in front of the Dolby Theatre and a Marshalls store with an orange 'LA LA LAND' souvenir shop. The street is busy with cars and pedestrians. She continues the same stylized choreography, moving her arms and hands in sharp, mechanical patterns while looking directly into the camera. (3) The setting shifts briefly to an indoor cafe where the woman holds a brown paper bag and a cup of black coffee, smiling at the viewer. Then, she is back outside in front of the Hollywood Wax Museum, a vibrant blue building with red and white lights. She performs the signature hand-crossing dance moves with a neutral, slightly detached expression. (4) She is filmed crouching on the sidewalk of the Hollywood Walk of Fame, surrounded by pink stars. She executes the same hand-waving movements. The video ends with her outside a storefront labeled 'BOPOMOFO', drinking from a cup with a straw while a question mark emoji appears above her head, showing a puzzled expression.
